definitions.explanation: A ship built and used for military purposes, including combat, patrol, or transport of troops.

examples.japanese: ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{軍艦|ぐんかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{停泊|ていはく}→停泊：20272_teihaku⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A warship was anchored in the harbor.

examples.english: At the end of the Edo period, foreign warships appeared off the coast of Japan, causing great shock.

notes:
{軍艦|ぐんかん} refers to any military ship. In modern usage, the word is commonly encountered in historical contexts, news, and popular culture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軍艦|ぐんかん}{島|じま} (Gunkanjima, Battleship Island — a famous abandoned island off Nagasaki)
- {軍艦|ぐんかん}{巻|ま}き (gunkan-maki — a type of sushi wrapped in nori resembling a warship)
- {軍艦|ぐんかん}マーチ (Gunkan March — a famous Japanese military march)

The word is a compound of ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧ (military) and {艦|かん} (warship). For specific types, Japanese uses compounds like ⟦{戦艦|せんかん}→戦艦：18783_senkan⟧ (battleship), ⟦{空母|くうぼ}→空母：15702_kuubo⟧ (aircraft carrier), and ⟦{駆逐艦|くちくかん}→駆逐艦：23389_kuchikukan⟧ (destroyer).
